This is first bail application u/S.439 of the Cr.P.C.
filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 19.04.2024 by Police Station- Crime Branch Bhopal, District Bhopal in connection with Crime No.59/2024, registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 120-B of IPC.

sentences.text: Atul Jain resident of Mandala and Trilok Patitar/ present applicant resident of Bhopal committed fraud of Rs.1,15,000/- through website Gold Desert Coin by making investment in Gold Desert Coin crypto Currency.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 19.04.2024.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.
The applicant is permanent resident of Bhopal and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He is ready to deposit the defrauded amount and abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made out.

Learned counsel for the State opposed the application contending that on the basis of the allegations and material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out and prays for rejection of bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the trial is not likely to conclude in near future and prolonged pre- trial detention being an anathema to the concept of liberty, this Court is inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant subject to deposit the whole defrauded amount in question.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed subject to deposit the whole defrauded amount and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his 3 MCRC-21130-2024 appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
5. The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
